# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `united-starlink-tracker` MCP server pointing at the tracker's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://unitedstarlinktracker.com/mcp`).
- No auth — the server is public and read-only, with no API key, OAuth login, or environment variable to configure.
- Logo: the tracker's own site icon, as published at unitedstarlinktracker.com.
